entities.summary: Fourth rashidun and first shia imam caliph was assassinated by a kharijite called abd al-rahman ibn 'amr ibn muljam al-muradi on 26 january 661, at the great mosque of kufah in present-day iraq Took place in Great Mosque of Kufa. Date: 661-01-29.
